compiled_state.title: [COMMIT-WORKFLOW]: Step 3 reads enforcement.strategy directly via grep -> does not honor dso.workflow=ci-pr -> projects with only dso.workflow set run full local validation including review gate
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## 1. Technical Environment
- Plugin: dso (worktree at 06c286d92b952bde401cbf6045ae60b5fcf94690)
- Files:
  - plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (lines 111, 115-116, 118, 121, 123, 126, 129-131, 139-143)
  - plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md (lines 3, 11, 15, 26, 34, 203, 206, 208-209, 216)
- code_version: 06c286d92b952bde401cbf6045ae60b5fcf94690

## 2. Incident Overview
- Scenario Type: User-Flagged Behavior (observed in a project without the f6fd fix; same gap exists in the current dso plugin's workflow files)

### Expected Behavior
When dso-config.conf has `dso.workflow=ci-pr` (canonical key per CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md), the commit workflow's enforcement-strategy gate should treat the effective strategy as "ci" and skip local validation (test/format/lint/review), deferring to the parity-uplifted CI llm-review job. This is the parallel of the fix landed for enforcement-gate.sh in commit ab071e8104.

### Actual Behavior
COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 3 reads enforcement.strategy directly:
```bash
ENFORCEMENT_STRATEGY=$(grep -m1 '^enforcement\.strategy=' "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/dso-config.conf" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-)
```
and later:
```bash
ENFORCEMENT_STRATEGY=$(".claude/scripts/dso" read-config.sh enforcement.strategy)
```
The second form passes `enforcement.strategy` to read-config.sh — which has a dso.workflow shim for the dso.workflow KEY but NOT for the enforcement.strategy key. So reading enforcement.strategy when only dso.workflow is set returns empty.

commit-workflow-validation.md Step 6 has the same pattern at line 206:
```bash
ENFORCEMENT_STRATEGY="$(".claude/scripts/dso read-config.sh" enforcement.strategy)"
```

When enforcement.strategy is empty (because only dso.workflow=ci-pr is set), the workflow defaults to "absent" → runs full local validation including the review gate. This is the same class of defect as bug f6fd (mode-detect.sh reading deprecated keys) and the now-fixed enforcement-gate.sh.

### Action History
Observed during /dso:fix-bug sessions for f6fd-af80-9b13-4649, b6e3-e771-d37b-436c+bbba-123d-659e-4cee, and 654e-7314-2d10-42c1 (all three required running the full local review workflow even though the project is canonically configured for ci-pr).

## 5. Skills and Workflows
- Affected workflow: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (Step 3 enforcement-strategy gate)
- Affected workflow: commit-workflow-validation.md (Step 6 review gate dispatch)

## 7. Suggested Fix
Replace the direct `enforcement.strategy` reads with calls to a helper that returns the EFFECTIVE strategy considering dso.workflow first:
- `dso.workflow=ci-pr` → enforcement.strategy=ci (skip local validation)
- `dso.workflow=local` → enforcement.strategy=local (run local validation)
- legacy enforcement.strategy=ci/local/both still honored as fallback

Two implementation options:
(A) Extend read-config.sh with a virtual key `commit.enforcement_strategy` that resolves dso.workflow first.
(B) Add a new helper script `resolve-enforcement-strategy.sh` that the workflow files call. Pattern mirrors enforcement-gate.sh's recent fix (ab071e8104).

Related:
- Fixed: enforcement-gate.sh (ab071e8104)
- Related: f6fd-af80-9b13-4649 (mode-detect.sh, fixed by fb2cc273a6)
- Filed today: 654e-7314-2d10-42c1 (record-review.sh path bug)
